name: Bloodveld

unlocks.name: Bigger and Badder
unlocks.notes: Allows superior Slayer monsters such as Insatiable Bloodveld and Insatiable mutated Bloodveld to spawn while on task.

variantInfo.name: Bloodveld
notes: For each tier of the Morytania Diary completed, players receive an additional 2.5% Slayer experience for bloodvelds slain at the Slayer Tower, adding 3 Slayer experience per tier per kill.

variantInfo.name: Bloodveld
notes: Slightly stronger God Wars bloodveld variant.
God Wars bloodvelds are Zamorak followers and will be aggressive unless the player has a Zamorak item equipped.

variantInfo.name: Insatiable Bloodveld
notes: Superior slayer monster variant that can spawn after purchasing Bigger and Badder.
Cannot spawn from Zamorak-aligned bloodvelds in the God Wars Dungeons.

variantInfo.name: Mutated Bloodveld
notes: Mutated bloodvelds have more hitpoints and a better drop table than normal bloodvelds.
Catacombs mutated bloodvelds can drop ancient shards and dark totem pieces and can be killed in multicombat.
Iorwerth Dungeon mutated bloodvelds can drop crystal shards and require Song of the Elves.
Meiyerditch Laboratories is multicombat and cannonable but requires partial Sins of the Father after killing the quest mutated bloodveld.
Buccaneers' Laboratory is multicombat, cannonable, requires 76 Sailing, and benefits from building the rowboat for Pirates' Cove access.

variantInfo.name: Insatiable mutated Bloodveld
notes: Superior slayer monster variant that can spawn from mutated bloodvelds after purchasing Bigger and Badder.

variantInfo.name: Reanimated bloodveld
notes: Counts for the corresponding Slayer task, giving 35 Slayer XP alongside Prayer XP.
Incidental reanimation target requiring the relevant Arceuus reanimation spell and ensouled head; not an independently spawned repeatable monster.
Reanimation works near the original drop while the head has not entered a bank, trade, Grand Exchange or price checker; otherwise use the Dark Altar.

locationComparison.name: Buccaneers' Laboratory
notes: 8 Mutated Bloodvelds.
Requires 76 Sailing to access the island.
The rowboat can be used to travel to Buccaneers' Haven from Pirates' Cove.
Since the area is multi-combat, it is one of the best places to use a dwarf multicannon for high Slayer experience per hour.
The drops will cover the use of the dwarf multicannon.

locationComparison.name: Catacombs of Kourend
notes: 18 Mutated Bloodvelds in three groups: north-east, south-east, and south-west.
The north-east location has the biggest cluster of seven mutated bloodvelds and is ideal for a goading potion.
The south-east group has five and is also suitable for goading potions.
The south-west group has six but is polluted by wandering possessed pickaxes; the path to hill giants can be used as a safespot.
Monsters here use the Catacombs drop table, and superior variants always drop a piece of the dark totem.

locationComparison.name: Iorwerth Dungeon
notes: 12 Mutated Bloodvelds.
The mutated bloodveld section is split into two sections of six bloodvelds each, and each section has a safespot.
This section is close to the dungeon entrance, making it easy to leave and return.
Requires Song of the Elves.

locationComparison.name: God Wars Dungeon
notes: 16 Bloodvelds.
Both a Saradomin item and a Zamorak item are required to use the safespot.
Rope is required to access the dungeon for the first time, and two more ropes are needed for first-time Saradomin's Encampment access.
The superior version will not spawn in this location.

locationComparison.name: Meiyerditch Laboratories
notes: 4 Bloodvelds and 7 Mutated Bloodvelds.
Since this area is multi-combat, it is one of the best places to use a dwarf multicannon for high Slayer experience per hour.
The drops will cover the use of the dwarf multicannon.
This location is somewhat hard to reach and requires partial completion of Sins of the Father.

locationComparison.name: Slayer Tower
notes: 15 Bloodvelds on the first floor.
For each tier of the Morytania Diary completed, Bloodvelds killed in the Slayer Tower receive additional Slayer experience.

locationComparison.name: Slayer Tower basement
notes: 12 Bloodvelds.
The Slayer ring can be used to teleport to the main entrance of the tower.
Fairy ring code CKS lands west of Canifis, just south of the tower.
The basement is only accessible on a Slayer task and may be less busy.

locationComparison.name: Stronghold Slayer Cave
notes: 12 Bloodvelds.
Use a Slayer ring to teleport directly to the entrance by Nieve.
Alternatively use the spirit tree to Tree Gnome Stronghold and run south-west, or necklace of passage to the Outpost and run north-east.

locationComparison.name: Wilderness God Wars Dungeon
notes: 5 Bloodvelds.
The Agility shortcut from Trollheim is much closer than running directly from Edgeville, but requires 64 Agility.
All monsters in the dungeon are aggressive unless the player has at least one item devoted to their god.
The superior version will not spawn in this location.
This is a dangerous multicombat Wilderness area with player killing risk.

taskNotes: Bloodvelds require 50 Slayer to damage and 50 combat to receive as a task.
Bloodvelds are demons and are affected by demonbane weapons.
An ash sanctifier may be brought for Prayer experience from ashes.
Bloodvelds have high Hitpoints and low Defence, making them good sources of combat and Slayer experience.
Bloodvelds attack with magic-based melee: they use melee attacks, but player magic defence determines their accuracy.
Use armour with decent magic defence, such as dragonhide or blood moon armour.
Players using protection prayers should use Protect from Melee rather than Protect from Magic.
Stronghold Slayer Cave is common because it is close to a bank and supports a dwarf multicannon.
Meiyerditch Laboratories are multi-combat and cannonable, and the mutated bloodveld room has a cluster of seven mutated bloodvelds.
Buccaneers' Laboratory requires 76 Sailing, is multicombat, is cannonable, and has no obstacles blocking bloodvelds.
Building the Buccaneers' Laboratory rowboat and bank chest makes accessing and banking there much faster.
Other mutated bloodveld locations, Catacombs of Kourend and Iorwerth Dungeon, are mainly recommended when assigned by Konar.
If assigned by Konar to the Slayer Tower, it is reasonable to kill bloodvelds there.
Konar tasks sending the player to God Wars Dungeon should be skipped because insatiable bloodvelds cannot spawn and AFK killing is impractical around aggressive monsters.
It is not recommended to kill Bloodveld assigned by Krystilia because Wilderness God Wars Dungeon is dangerous multicombat Wilderness with sparse spawns.
Expert Reanimation on ensouled bloodveld heads can be used as a low-Slayer-experience Prayer-training alternative that still counts toward the task.
recommendedMethod: For regular tasks, use Stronghold Slayer Cave with a cannon for low attention or Meiyerditch Laboratories/Buccaneers' Laboratory mutated bloodvelds for high experience. Wear magic-defence armour, pray Protect from Melee if using Prayer, and prefer demonbane melee where using direct combat.
